definitions.explanation: Baby talk word for food or eating. One of the first words many Japanese children learn.

examples.japanese: まんまの{時間|じかん}だよ。
{赤|あか}ちゃんが「まんま」と{言|い}った。

notes:
WORD FORMATION: From {飯|まま} (cooked rice, meal) with vowel change for baby talk.

USAGE: One of the earliest words Japanese babies learn to say, along with ママ (mama) and パパ (papa).

NOTE: Not to be confused with the adverb まんま (as is, unchanged), which has different origins.

RELATED BABY TALK WORDS:
- おてて (hands)
- おめめ (eyes)
- あんよ (feet/walking)
- ねんね (sleep)

RELATED WORDS:
- ごはん (rice, meal - neutral)
- {食事|しょくじ} (meal - formal)
